terms.age (linear, +): recovered: age ramp, risk rises with age (the ramp switching off at the oldest is a network artefact on 1056 rows, flagged by the explainer itself)
terms.bmi hinge above 29.5 (+): recovered: obesity hinge, off below about 30, steep above
terms.income (linear in log income, -): recovered: low income adds risk through a hinge (a reasonable reading of a convex decreasing effect)
terms.smoker step (+): recovered: smoking raises risk (read through the age ramp and the protective non-smoker unit)
terms.unused inputs: recovered: visits, score, female, urban, insured and noise move the prediction little

terms.hinge 2: income relative to score (-): recovered: income_score_hinge, high income relative to score is protective and a higher score cancels it
terms.hinge 3: visits plus smoking (+): recovered: visits_smoker_hinge, smoking lowers the visit threshold and adds to it
terms.unused inputs: recovered: female, urban, insured and noise barely change the prediction

terms.age (linear, +): recovered: age_risk, older means higher risk

terms.unused inputs: recovered: visits, score, insured and noise have small effects
